create_model_wrapper: create a subclass of ModelWrapper to wrap a PyTorch nn.Module with custom forward pass logic
run_model_wrapper_forward: run the ModelWrapper forward method passing input tensor x, time tensor t, and optional extras
test_model_wrapper: test the ModelWrapper by wrapping a dummy nn.Module and verifying forward passes x and t correctly
refactor_model_wrapper_forward: refactor the ModelWrapper forward method to add custom preprocessing before calling the wrapped model
review_model_wrapper_class: review the ModelWrapper abstract class that wraps an nn.Module and forwards x, t, and extras to it
